data.text:
### scale proof
Global fintech with 4 named case studies (Alcaston, GoTrade, Kadmos, Littlepay), self-called unicorn — independent scale uncertain.
### problem mechanism
Fragmented cross-border cards, local methods, payouts, FX, onboarding unified via single API — customer pain uncertain.
### cost evidence
Site claims 97% auth rates and $2.5M fee savings — vendor marketing only, uncertain independent cost.
### counter-evidence
Pricing pages fetched 404, no public data-team pain found; API-native firm may handle data in-house — uncertain.
### wedge fit
Possible auth/reconciliation analytics wedge, but no evidenced data problem on rapyd.net domain — uncertain fit.
### verdict (worth 3-6k/month: yes or no)
no
### why
No verified mechanism-plus-cost pain from company domain to justify paid fix; only marketing claims.
